text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A fan letter for Haru Urara arrives.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hey look, Trainer! Someone wrote something really nice to me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: They wrote, "Seeing you always try your best gives me courage!" It's making me blush!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Y'know… This is top secret, but I stayed strong and I only ate two carrots today.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So, I'm definitely gonna come out on top next race! That'll definitely make my fans happy, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heehee! That's what I thought! They'll be stoked! Okey-dokey! I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling the love from her fans, Haru Urara's motivation seems to skyrocket.
